newsitem.title: USA: Peoples limits Ill. gas deliveries Thurs.
newsitem.headline: Peoples limits Ill. gas deliveries Thurs.

text.p: Peoples Energy Co said Wednesday it imposed limits Thursday on natural gas deliveries from Illinois pipelines and storage facilities because of a cold snap in the Midwest.
"Our transportation customers will have to live within the limits on the system or have to face a penalty," said company spokesman Ed Joyce.
He said firm customers, mostly residential ones, will not be affected by the limitations, called a "critical day".

"Supplies are going to be somewhat tight on us," he said after the company was notified Tuesday by Natural Gas Pipeline Co of America (NGPL) about the severe demand on the system due to the deep freeze.
NGPL is a major conduit delivering gas to Peoples Energy's two natural gas utilities in Illinois, Peoples Gas Light & Coke Co and North Shore Gas Co.
The two utilities have a combined customer base of 980,000 in Chicago
Northern Illinois Gas Co, which receives much of its gas via NGPL, also declared a critical day on deliveries for Thursday.
On Thursday, temperatures in the greater Chicago area were predicted to reach -7 to -10 Fahrenheit, coupled with snow and blustery winds.
"The temperatures are supposed to warm up over the weekend," Joyce said.
